page.definition_block: Team Assemblers assemble and inspect product components according to standard processes on manufacturing lines. They load materials, assemble and fasten parts, connect wiring, and perform visual inspections, coordinating with team members to meet cycle-time and quality standards.

rows.label: Education Requirement

responsibilities_block: Assemble and fasten parts according to the process.
Load materials, connect wiring, install clips, and perform related operations.
Conduct self-inspection and visual inspection according to standards.
Coordinate with the team to meet production cycle time.
Record quality problems and report improvement needs.
Follow safety standards and inspect equipment.
page.work_context_block: Production-line cycle time sets the rhythm. Once line speed is fixed, your movements must keep up. Model changes require learning new processes, while busy seasons bring faster lines and more overtime. Inspection stations report problems from your workstation, and you correct them immediately. Workstation space is limited, standing all day is common, and complete personal protective equipment is mandatory.
